title: GMSK Modulator
text: Modulate data bits using Gaussian minimum shift keying (GMSK) method, 3 inputs, 3 outputs, {Symbol prehistory} sets Symbol prehistory; {Bandwidth time product} sets the product of the bandwidth and symbol time for the Gaussian pulse, {Pulse length}, {Phase offset (rad)} sets the phase offset of modulated waveform, {Number of samples per symbol}, {Number of data points}, {Output type}, {Output word length} and {Enable reset input port} sets the reset signal. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: data
ports.summary: Modulated complex output data symbols complex scalar | complex column vector

params.name: Bandwidth time product
params.values: Product of the bandwidth and symbol time for the Gaussian pulse shape 0.3 (default) | positive scalar value

params.name: Pulse length
params.values: Pulse length 8 (default) | positive integer in the range from 1 to 16

params.name: Symbol prehistory
params.values: Symbol prehistory 1 (default) | -1 | vector of –1s or 1s with length equal to L – 1

params.name: Phase offset (rad)
params.values: Phase offset of modulated waveform 0 (default) | numeric scalar in the range from -2*π to 2*π.

params.name: Number of samples per symbol
params.values: Number of samples per symbol 4 (default) | in the range 1 to 64

params.name: Number of data points
params.values: Number of data points 1024 (default) | positive integer within the range 65,536 and a power of 2

params.name: Output word length
params.values: Output word length 16 (default) | positive scalar value with word length less than 16
